fluff.overview: Word of Blake Militia infantry served as the backbone of Protectorate garrison forces across dozens of conquered worlds, providing the manpower for territorial control that the Militia's BattleMech and armor assets could not sustain alone. Mechanized tracked Level I formations rode APCs that could keep pace with armor across broken terrain, providing the all-terrain mobility and armor protection that garrison duty on undeveloped worlds demanded. The tracked transport kept these troops mobile even on worlds where roads were poor or nonexistent. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems that extend the platoon's engagement envelope well beyond personal weapon range, these troops provide indirect fire support that can suppress enemy positions from distances where return fire is difficult.
